user: Unrelated question: what is the fee for an international transfer?
answer:
An international transfer is a SWIFT transfer, which Verta's tariff schedule charges as:

- **Flat fee:** EUR 15.00
- **Percentage fee:** 0.3% of the EUR equivalent of the amount sent

For example, a EUR 1,000.00 SWIFT transfer would cost EUR 15.00 + EUR 3.00 (0.3%) = **EUR 18.00** in Verta fees.

Correspondent banks may deduct their own charges along the way. Verta doesn't control those and doesn't refund them.

fragments.text:
Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.

Fee details
## How the SWIFT fee is composed
A SWIFT transfer carries a flat fee plus a percentage of the EUR equivalent of
the amount sent. Correspondent bank charges deducted en route are outside the
control of Verta and are not refunded.

Fee details
## Fee refunds
A fee is refunded only when the underlying transaction is reversed because of a
Verta error. Fees on customer-initiated reversals are not refunded.
